titles.romaji: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Ringo Bouya to Minna no Negai
titles.english: Anpanman: Apple Boy and Everyone’s Hope
titles.native: それいけ! アンパンマン りんごぼうやとみんなの願い

description:
An aspiring super hero gets his chance for bravery when a witch transforms his village into an uninhabitable mess. Now, he must save the day!
